title: Arnold Press
summary: A seated dumbbell press that starts palms in and rotates outward as you press.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for front delts (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.5 for side delts (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly side delts total.
Library rating 0.5 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.3 for traps (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly traps total.

setup.text: Sit holding dumbbells at chin height with your palms facing you.
Press up, rotating your palms to face forward as you go.
Reverse the rotation as you lower.

form_cues.cue: Rotate palms forward as you press
Reverse the rotation on the way down
Keep the rotation smooth. It's part of the press, not a separate move.

mistakes.text: Rushing the rotation and losing control.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Similar muscles; dumbbell instead of dumbbell.
Swap sheet: One side at a time.
Swap sheet: More stable, Less systemic fatigue, Easier to learn.
Swap sheet: More stable, Independent arm levers, Less systemic fatigue.
